data.change_summary: No additional amendments were required after the final review. The existing shrimp stage-model implementation remains the shipped result: stage and egg cohort helper math now uses saturating counts, deterministic stage progression and berried/hatch transfers preserve count accounting, legacy and current saves keep loading through the staged runtime-parameter migration path, and snapshot/API/TUI surfaces expose readable total and per-stage shrimp breakdowns with focused regression coverage for empty-stage reseeding and births-minus-deaths conservation.
outstanding_risks: Workspace-wide validation is still blocked by the pre-existing bead 6e5.7.1 regression in `algae_growth.rs`; this task was approved without addressing that unrelated compile failure.
Legacy-only maturation-days inputs still map to juvenile/sub-adult durations through the documented 60/40 split unless callers set explicit stage durations.

The conservation regression intentionally freezes promotions to isolate births-versus-deaths accounting, so there is still no single combined test covering births, promotions, and deaths simultaneously.
